notes: Hurling has no standalone numeric ID on the betting-tips sitemap; OLBG files Gaelic games under 'Gaelic Football' (25) and the /betting-tips hub. Hurling is excluded by the brief.
Specials (TV / Politics / Awards) do not appear in the betting-tips sitemap at all; they are only visible in the blogs taxonomy. Excluded by the brief.
UFC/MMA has no separate sport ID; OLBG routes those markets through Boxing (16). Excluded by the brief.
Greyhounds (28) is present in the sitemap and tipster competition but does not appear in the /sitemap navigation block - a discrepancy worth noting.
